notes.title: Version 1.40 released!
notes.notes:
A sizable update is here featuring:


New menu music!
Leaderboards work again!
Chocolate milk no longer looks like blood in the milk meter!
Balance tweaks for the opposable thumb!
Fixes for two rare bugs that could cause a crash!


Stay tuned for the one year anniversary of Farmageddon: A Cattle Royale next month!

notes.title: The Holiday Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! Thanks for waiting! 

The winter seasonal update is available to all players. It features a new snowy aesthetic and sound effects, bug fixes, balance tweaks and a new item!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38068271/cbae6d3c053e1dab5467cc3062442dc8de07a95c.png
What could be in the box? Why don't you go find out!

I've also prepared a little easter egg for the game on the 25th, so I hope you'll check it out!

As always, if you enjoy the game, reviews REALLY help. Have a good winter sale! (I hear Bedlamball's pretty good. I'm not biased. I swear.)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38068271/0ca211090d98516a929157eb9fd61c2b6037b13f.jpg

MOO-ry Christmas! (runs for cover)

-Solidplasma

notes.title: Winter Update approaches!
notes.notes:
Hi folks! Got a few announcements about the game today!

First, have a look at this!
[previewyoutube=ZZ65F-QAPVk;full][/previewyoutube]

The winter update is nearly ready! There's one more thing I want to add, but if you're subscribed to my Twitch, you can try the beta now with the code in my Discord's subscriber's section. Otherwise, I'm gonna try and release the update in the next week!

notes.title: TAUREN TERROR UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
IT'S FINALLY HERE!


[previewyoutube=XSkmCB_Beww;full][/previewyoutube]

I've been teasing it for a while, but the fall seasonal update featuring 3 new passive items, new unlockable skins, graphics music and much more is live now! And it's free!

As always, if you like the game, reviews and word of mouth really help, and if you have any trouble, you can email me via the support email, tweet me, or join the discord!

I hope you enjoy the update, the team worked really hard on it!

Happy Halloween!

-Solidplasma

notes.title: Autumn update is in the works!
notes.notes:
Happy spooky season, everyone! We've got some exciting news!

We've been working on an autumn update to the game! I've been holding off on posting too much, because most of the seasonal assets aren't ready yet, but we hope to have it out by the end of the month! This update will include new skins, 3 new passive items, and seasonal graphic changes!

Here's a look at one of the new items, the Crystal Bull, which works kind of like the lens of truth in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38068271/61fcd0ee8f53f69e289d1cf7136825a258acfb41.gif

Also, if you're subscribed to Solidplasma's Twitch Channel, you can try these items and other changes early on the beta branch! Check out the Subscriber Central area of the community discord, where you can find a the beta branch access code! We also work on the game live on twitch at 6pm US Eastern time every Tuesday, if you want to ask the dev anything.

See you real soon,

Solidplasma

notes.title: Version 1.15 released and the future of the game!
notes.notes:
Long time, no updates. Moo me.

In all seriousness though, I've been wanting to update the game for a while, and I apologize for the delay. As the project lead and only client programmer, I've got my work cut out for me. This update includes, new leaderboards, bug fixes and various quality of life improvements. If you encounter any errors, please shoot me and email at evan (at) solidplasmastudios (dot) com.

I would love to do a Halloween update with new skins and items. If you enjoy the game and want to see this, spreading the word really helps, as does streaming it. The game  has its own category on Twitch. Every little bit of exposure helps.

Until next time!

-Solidplasma

notes.title: Version 1.14 released!
notes.notes:
So, uh, apologies to anyone who tried to launch the game the past couple of days and got an error. It should now be resolved. Here's a list of the changes/fixes!


 Fixed a crash upon trying to play the game.
 We've added a new Leaderboard: Pasture Protectors! This leaderboard shows the top 10 steam account who have had a cow in the divine pasture the longest!
 Recent Victors Leaderboard should no longer reset with the seed
 Farmers should drop hearts more freqeuently
 Various minor Quality of Life and bug fixes


Thanks for playing the game!

-Solidplasma
